title: The Child Phool Is Brought Before Guru Hargobind

blocks.text: The new episode begins with a child's grief and longing. Hearing that all others had gone to see the Guru, the orphaned Phool weeps until Kala finally brings him along, Carrying a bowl of curd as a humble offering.

In the Guru's presence the child expresses need more powerfully than speech. Phool prostrated himself before the Guru and, patting his empty stomach, silently asks for protection, livelihood, and a place in the world after his father's death in battle.
This page gives the Phulkian line a sacred emotional origin. Before there is prophecy or rule, there is a vulnerable child received under the Guru's gaze.
